description: The file defines a foreground service for Android in Kotlin that manages a node connection status, displays notifications with runtime status updates, handles actions like disconnect, and creates necessary notification channels.

classes.name: NodeForegroundService
classes.description: Android foreground service managing connection status notifications and service lifecycle.

classes.name: Quint
classes.description: Data class to hold combined runtime status information.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes notification channel and starts foreground notification updates based on runtime status.

methods.name: onStartCommand
methods.description: Handles start commands, particularly the stop action and maintains service run state.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up coroutines and jobs when service is destroyed.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns null as binding is not used.

methods.name: ensureChannel
methods.description: Creates notification channel if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: buildNotification
methods.description: Constructs a notification with the provided title and text.

methods.name: startForegroundWithTypes
methods.description: Starts foreground service or updates notification if already started.
